name: Hiquill
summary: Learns a brand, mines search demand, writes articles and publishes them on your own domain automatically each week.
description: Learns a brand, mines search demand, writes articles and publishes them on your own domain automatically each week.

pricing.details: Free. Starter 35 €/month per site (about 2 posts/week). Growth 115 €/month (almost daily posts; 29 €/site at 4 sites, as stated). Agency 356 €/month (120 articles, up to 30 sites at 31 €/month each). Enterprise 891 €/month (300 articles, up to 80 sites). 14-day free trial on Starter and Growth. Unlimited traffic on paid plans.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Learns a brand, mines search demand, and publishes articles on your own domain
Human-sounding weekly or near-daily posts, depending on the plan
14-day free trial on Starter and Growth
